bitpanda.attack_found: None that moves the band. No priced round, tender or down round since the Aug 2021 Series C. Jan 2026 reports (Bloomberg via The Block / TradingView) had Bitpanda targeting a Frankfurt IPO at up to $5B in H1 2026; Finance Magnates 2026-09-15 reports the CEO departing and the IPO delayed. 2025 EBITDA fell 75% (trendingtopics 2026-03-11) but the company stays profitable and is being hired by Raiffeisen (Sep 2026). The mark is stale (>24 months) but there is no documented collapse evidence (no write-down or sub-$1B tender found), so the $4.1B mark stands under Rule A.

valuation.quote: Accordingly, GoStudent is now only worth €903 million (or $969 million) to its lead investor.

gostudent.attack_found: YES, collapse evidence against the stale $3.5B mark. Recorded mark: Series D Jan 2022, 'a notional $3.5 billion / €3 billion valuation' (TechCrunch 2022-01-11). Lead investor Prosus's annual reports wrote its stake down 29% (2023) and 57.5% more (2024), implying EUR 903M / $969M (trendingtopics 2024-06-28). The company itself confirms no priced round since: 'We completed our last equity financing round at the beginning of 2022. This was also the last time our valuation was determined.' The Aug 2023 $95M raise was therefore not a priced equity round. No 2025-2026 round found (Google News: 'GoStudent funding', 'GoStudent Finanzierungsrunde', 'GoStudent Bewertung', 'GoStudent Prosus'). Mark >24 months old plus a lead-investor write-down below $1B: read below_1b, which matches the Coatue sibling.

entry.quote: 21 Sept 2016 Shareholder: Econnext GmbH, Speedinvest Scouts GmbH & Co. KG
entry.round_label_source: The firm's own archived 2018 portfolio listing tags GoStudent pre_seed with invest year 2016 (https://index.commoncrawl.org/CC-MAIN-2018-26-index?url=https%3A%2F%2Fspeedinvest.com%2Fportfolio%2F&output=json); the register shows the Speedinvest Scouts vehicle entering in Sept 2016, seven months after the Feb 2016 founding, and Speedinvest II joining on 12 Apr 2018.

gostudent.notes: Recommend: flip the band from 1b_plus ($3.5B, Jan 2022) to below_1b on the Prosus write-down, aligned with Coatue. usd 969000000 is the implied write-down value, not a priced round. The register page is the entry citation; the Pre-Seed label is the firm's own filter tag.
